notes.title: Radar Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I released a small patch to fix a bug that occurred when the player saved the game while the radar was zoomed out. After loading the game, the radar remained zoomed in and could not be zoomed out anymore.

Big thanks to the players [u][b]irnnn[/b][/u] and [u][b]Shved[/b][/u] for pointing that out. ːsteamthumbsupː

The patch will be automatically applied the next time you restart Steam. The fix will work on saves where the bug has not occurred and will prevent it from happening again for new players who start the game.

notes.title: Void Crawler launching soon 🚀🎮
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to share that the definitive release date for Void Crawler is April 3, 2024! Development is complete, and I'm just adding some final touches before launch.

I also want to express my heartfelt thanks for all the support I've been receiving.

The Demo will be removed on 29 March before launch.

I can't wait to share the finished game with you all on April 3rd! 🚀🎮

Best regards,
Ricardo
